verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships an official MCP server, both remote-hosted at api.perplexity.ai/mcp and local over stdio, so AI assistants can call its search tools directly. It documents per-tool enable/disable, an MCP-connector example for Anthropic Messages API requests, and a pplx CLI that returns JSON 'ready for shell pipelines and agent tool calls'. That covers the core of a ready-made agent tool. Missing for 10: explicitly published function-calling/JSON tool schemas for non-MCP use, named agent-framework integrations (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex), independent hands-on corroboration.
